record_id.description: Stable UUID chosen from original country, locality and name; never changed by a rename or capacity update.

entity_type.description: Catalogue entity; projects only in version 1.

name.description: Named battery project, not the entire solar or wind facility.

locality.description: Source-reported locality; not a geocoded coordinate.

location_accuracy.description: Accuracy and basis of source-reported coordinates.

capacity_scope.description: Exact project, phases or expansion represented by the numeric capacities. Prevents project/phase double counting.

status.description: Last source-supported status, not a live operational assessment.

status_as_of.description: Date supporting status; for undated live project pages, date accessed. Does not imply COD.

status_date_basis.description: Whether status_as_of is a dated publication or access to an undated project page.

power_basis.description: Electrical basis for reported battery power. Unspecified is never silently converted to AC.

energy_basis.description: Reported energy basis. Nominal, usable and unspecified are not interchangeable.

connection_type.description: Explicit grid or microgrid connection; null if not sourced.

configuration.description: Standalone, co-located generation or microgrid when supported.

chemistry.description: Battery chemistry only where explicitly reported; flow batteries are included.

commercial_operation_date.description: Confirmed commercial operation date, if known to the day; never an inauguration date by default.

expected_operation_date.description: Source-stated planned operation date, if known to the day; never automatically promotes project status.

capex_scope.description: What the reported capital expenditure includes.

quality_status.description: Source-backed research record or unresolved field conflict.

notes.description: Editorial limitations, exclusions and interpretation notes.

aliases.description: Other names for this same project.

owners.description: Reported project owners; ownership shares belong in extensions.

epc_contractors.description: Reported engineering, procurement and construction contractors.

battery_manufacturers.description: Reported cell or battery suppliers, without inferring from integrator.

applications.description: Reported grid services or use cases.

sources.description: Source registry IDs used by this record.

source_urls.description: Derived sorted unique URLs from sources.json.

power_capacity_mw.description: Reported BESS power only; excludes PV power and site interconnection rating.

energy_capacity_mwh.description: Reported battery stored-energy capacity for capacity_scope.

duration_hours.description: Source-reported discharge duration; not calculated from mixed-basis ratings.

grid_connection_capacity_mw.description: Whole-site grid connection limit, distinct from BESS power.

co_located_solar_mw.description: Reported co-located PV capacity; basis described in extensions/notes.

round_trip_efficiency_pct.description: Source-reported round-trip efficiency; boundary and conditions in extensions.

capex.description: Capital expenditure in currency; scope must be documented.

design_life_years.description: Source-reported design/operating life, not inferred warranty.

latitude.description: Source-reported WGS84 latitude; no city-centroid substitutes.

longitude.description: Source-reported WGS84 longitude; no city-centroid substitutes.

commercial_operation_year.description: Actual COD year when exact date is not available.

container_count.description: Reported count of battery containers, not cells or racks.

field_sources_json.description: JSON object mapping each populated factual field to source IDs; no wildcard evidence.

phases_json.description: JSON list of documented phase metadata; phases are not also separate rows for this same scope.

external_ids_json.description: JSON object of namespaced registry IDs for cross-source deduplication.

extensions_json.description: JSON object of additional namespaced metadata that has not been standardized.

conflicts_json.description: JSON object of conflicting source observations with source IDs; requires needs_review.

created_at.description: UTC date/time this record was first added.

updated_at.description: UTC date/time of the latest substantive edit.

last_verified_at.description: UTC source-access time; not proof of current operational availability.
